name: Highborne
description: You grew up among the wealthy and powerful — a noble household, a merchant dynasty, or a temple's inner circle. You learned the manners of court, the weight of titles, and the cost of a public reputation.

feature.name: Privilege
feature.text: You have advantage on rolls to consort with nobles, royalty, and other high-ranking members of society.

name: Loreborne
description: You grew up in a community devoted to learning — a great library, a scholarly order, a guild of cartographers, or a monastery whose monks copy histories by candlelight.

feature.name: Well-Read
feature.text: You have advantage on rolls to recall historical, cultural, or academic knowledge that your community would have preserved.

name: Orderborne
description: You grew up within a strict, hierarchical group — a knightly order, a martial school, a religious sect, or a guild bound by oath. You know the comfort and weight of a rigid code.

feature.name: Dedicated
feature.text: At the start of each session, choose one tenet of your code. While you act in accordance with that tenet, you may spend Hope to gain bonuses as if you had additional Hope.

name: Ridgeborne
description: You grew up in the mountains — among high passes, narrow trails, and folk who measure the year by snowfall. You know how to read weather, stone, and silence.

feature.name: Steady
feature.text: You have advantage on rolls to traverse mountainous, rocky, or high-altitude terrain, and to keep your footing on uncertain ground.

name: Seaborne
description: You grew up on or beside the sea — a fishing village, a port town, a caravel that never quite finished its last voyage. Salt and tide shaped you as much as any kin.

feature.name: Know the Tide
feature.text: You can describe the tides, currents, and weather of any sea or large river you have visited before, and gain advantage on rolls to sail, swim, or navigate water.

name: Slyborne
description: You grew up in a community that thrived on cleverness and stealth — a thieves' guild, a smuggling family, a network of fences, or any group that succeeds by not being seen.

feature.name: Scoundrel
feature.text: You have advantage on rolls to deceive, swindle, or barter in your favor when interacting with someone who does not know your reputation.

name: Underborne
description: You grew up beneath the surface — a deep city, a network of caverns, a sunless district. You read shadow and stone the way other folk read sun and sky.

feature.name: Low-Light Living
feature.text: You can see clearly in dim light and have advantage on rolls to navigate, hide, or move silently in dark or confined spaces.

name: Wanderborne
description: You grew up on the road — a traveling caravan, a roving troupe, a family without a fixed home. You learned a hundred small kindnesses and how to be at ease as a stranger.

feature.name: Nomadic Pack
feature.text: Add a Nomadic Pack to your inventory. Once per session you may pull one mundane, useful item from the pack as if you had thought to bring it; describe what it is when you draw it.

name: Wildborne
description: You grew up far from settled places — deep forests, open plains, untamed reaches. You know which berries to eat, which tracks to follow, and which silences mean danger.

feature.name: Lightfoot
feature.text: You have advantage on rolls to move quietly or to remain unseen in natural environments.
